signs.title: Route 19
lines: Route 19 — from the beach to the open sea.
North: Fuchsia City. South: the sea route toward the Seafoam Islands.

signs.title: Surf safely
lines: You need Surf to travel beyond this point.
Prepare your Pokémon before setting out to sea!

signs.title: Coastal wildlife
lines: There is plenty of life above the tideline, too.
Wild Pokémon hide among the coastal grasses!
